title: Construction and Brown adjunction for the strict etale compact-support functor
statement:
Let $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ have characteristic $p$ and let $\ell\ne p$ be prime [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism of finite-type $k$-schemes, with no separatedness assumption on $Y$, and fix a compactification $X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{p_f}Y$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite, $O=\mathcal O_E$, and let $t\in O$ be nonzero and not a unit [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Put $A_n=O/(t^n)$ for $n\ge1$. Use strict systems $\mathsf S_A(W_{\mathrm{et}})$, evaluation $e_n$, and their ordinary unbounded derived categories as in [lem-pur-coefficient-system-derived-comparison]. Set $F_A=Rp_{f,A,*}j_{!,A}$ and $F_n=Rp_{f,*,A_n}j_!$. 
The coefficient rings $A_n$ are finite and annihilated by powers of $\ell$, their transitions are surjective, and $O\cong\varprojlim_nO/(t^n)$. The category of systems is Grothendieck abelian, with coproducts, cohomology and cohomological bounds computed componentwise. The functor $F_A$ is a well-defined exact $O$-linear functor on the whole unbounded derived category and preserves arbitrary set-indexed coproducts in the chosen universe. Its canonical evaluation comparison is $e_nF_A\cong F_ne_n$, with the evaluated open/proper adjunction units, counits and coefficient transitions.

Let $L_n\dashv e_n$ be derived left extension [lem-pur-system-level-left-extension], so $e_mL_nP=A_m\otimes^L_{A_n}P$ for $m\le n$ and is zero for $m>n$. The canonical coefficient projection comparisons give actual natural isomorphisms $F_AL_n\cong L_nF_n$, whose level-$m$ maps for $m\le n$ are the inverses of the projection isomorphisms $q$ for $A_n\to A_m$ of [lem-pur-etale-system-coefficient-projection]. They respect all strict transitions.

There is an adjunction $F_A\dashv G_A$ on these unbounded derived categories. Its right adjoint has the $O$-linear and coherent shift structures induced by adjunction, its unit and counit respect those structures, and $G_A$ is exact for that shift structure. The functor, adjunction and comparisons have their map action in the derived category, independent of choices of resolutions.

proof.text: Apply nonunit_coefficient_stages. In the domain O, nonzero t is regular, so the existing compact-support construction supplies S.

Transport the Grothendieck structure along coefficientSystemEquivalence to StrictRingSystem. System evaluation preserves coproducts; the exact-derived homology comparison gives componentwise cohomology. Componentwise vanishing of homology gives the common-bound iff statements.

The given exact inverse-image models are isomorphic to mapDerivedCategory. Transfer their shift and triangulated structures and then transfer these to their adjoints. Their composite S.functor is exact and additive. The existing normalized scalar action supplies O-linearity.

Finite-type schemes over the field are locally Noetherian and quasi-compact. Apply the published proper finite-ring coproduct theorem. The geometric realization equivalences and their normalized proper comparison transport coproduct preservation to the given proper derived model. Open extension is a left adjoint. The evaluation comparison and joint detection of colimits prove S.functor preserves coproducts.

Transport to the Grothendieck-sized derived localizations and apply Brown representability, then transport back. Choose the rightAdjoint with ofIsLeftAdjoint. Adjunction transfers additivity, coherent shifts and exactness. A direct Hom-transpose proof transfers scalars; naturality proves the scalar equations for unit and counit.

Apply the separate geometric comparison lemma for this S. Use the explicitly constructed proper/open insertion isomorphisms and their proved conjugacy identities, and assemble all fields of StrictEtaleBrownConstruction.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q24-c082b9edf (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: PASS. Split with no new nodes; statement and stmt_deps unchanged, and no repair note exists, so the re-split rule does not apply. Sources checked in the local Zheng PDF: Construction 4.1 (printed p. 21) gives e_{n!} and the tensor-or-zero formula; Lemma 5.13 (p. 34) gives the proper left-extension comparison via Lemma 4.10 and the projection formula; Constructions 5.14–5.15 and Lemma 5.16 (pp. 34–35) give Rf_! = proper∘open, the evaluation isomorphism and Brown. The item is the fixed-compactification form of this on ordinary small-étale strict systems over O/(t^n); no pro-étale category is substituted and no SGA is cited. Step by step: (1) DVR clause 5 gives t=uπ^r with r≥1; local-field stages with E=F gives finite ℓ-power-torsion rings; adic-limit clause 2 with M=O plus cofinality gives completeness. (2) The left-extension node supplies the Grothendieck category, componentwise coproducts and cohomology, joint detection and L_n⊣e_n. (3) The coefficient-system comparison applies because step 1 gives a non-zero-divisor and completeness; the semilinear-sections node supplies j_!. (4) Exactness and O-linearity come from exact factorization, the closed right-derived-triangulated node and K-injective linearity. (5) The Noetherian node covers X̄ over Y without separated Y; the proper finite-ring coproduct node is on small étale sites; the canonical comparison is evaluated and detected, including the empty family. (6) β is unit-normalized by conjugate uniqueness. (7) I checked the mate λ against def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate (L_2=P_A, G=L_n, H=L_n, L_1=P_n); at m≤n its scalar transpose equals the defining transpose of q in coefficient-projection applied to (id, p_f), and it vanishes for m>n. (8) Mate pasting and the composition equation of q give q^{-1} levelwise, matching the statement's direction. (9) Brown, linear right adjoint, shift (iii) and triangulated right adjoint: hypotheses met. (10) Independence of resolutions via K-injective universality. proof_deps equals the union of uses. Tool uses: the 8 declared generic tools are accepted; lem-pc-right-derived-functor-triangulated is slopmaster2-closed and so needs no declaration. Maintainer note: the existing unsplit lem-pur-etale-tower-brown-adjunction overlaps this item (it requires separated X and Y, a uniformizer and an arbitrary field of characteristic p); consider merging later. No fixes.
